subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Compilar as ideias-chave de textos por meio de tomada de notas.

components.description_pt: Identificar ideias-chave em um texto enquanto lê ou escuta
components.description_en: Identify key ideas in a text while reading or listening
components.cc_component_description: Identify two or more central ideas in an informational text

components.description_pt: Registrar ideias-chave de um texto usando estratégias concisas de anotação
components.description_en: Record key ideas from a text using concise note-taking strategies
components.cc_component_description: Select and record key details from provided sources with adult guidance

components.description_pt: Organizar anotações de um texto refletindo seus pontos principais com precisão
components.description_en: Organize notes taken from a text to reflect its main points accurately
components.cc_component_description: Summarize the main points a speaker makes during a presentation or discussion

cc_matches.description: Summarize the points a speaker makes and explain how each claim is supported by reasons and evidence.
Determine two or more central ideas in a text and analyze their development over the course of the text; provide an objective summary of the text.
With guidance and support from adults, recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.
